## Context
The approved duration analysis on `stalwart-allstar-jaguarundi` measured current operator-visible durations for the two LLM-gated ticket operations. Agent guidance must set explicit wait expectations without including sample-size or long-tail warnings.

## Plan
- Update the gate-protocol guidance in `AGENTS.md` to state that `review-plan` takes 15 to 20 minutes.
- State in the same guidance that a completion-verifier-gated close takes 9 to 11 minutes.
- Keep the wording operational and concise. Do not add methodology, percentile, sample-size, legacy-tail, or uncertainty text.
- Do not change gate behavior, configuration, or any generated documentation.
- Submit the documentation-only change through Gerrit and rely on CI for verification.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `AGENTS.md` tells agents to expect 15 to 20 minutes for `review-plan`.
- [x] `AGENTS.md` tells agents to expect 9 to 11 minutes for a completion-verifier-gated close.
- [x] The maintained guidance contains no warning about sample size, legacy tails, or uncertainty.
- [x] No production code, configuration, or other documentation file changes.
- [x] Gerrit CI passes the documentation-only change.
